title: Closing the loop: telling customers what happened to their idea
excerpt: People forgive a no. They do not forgive silence. A simple routine for answering every request, eventually.
content:
People forgive a no. They do not forgive silence. Most feedback tools are good at collecting requests and bad at the second half: telling the person what became of theirs.

A routine that takes ten minutes a week

  • When something ships, write to everyone who asked for it
  • When something is declined, say so, with one sentence of why
  • Once a quarter, publish what changed because of feedback

The first of these is the cheapest marketing a product team will ever do.
